gui.appliedas.wand.title: ME Resonating Wand
gui.appliedas.wand.items_detail: Off: take blocks from your inventory
gui.appliedas.wand.items_hint: When enabled, use ME building blocks first and fill any shortage from your inventory. When disabled, use only your inventory. Fluids and recovered blocks still use the linked ME network.
gui.appliedas.wand.fluids_hint: Fill missing infuser pools with Liquid Starlight from ME (1,000 mB per source). When disabled, leave the pools unchanged.
gui.appliedas.wand.replace_hint: Recover replaceable building blocks with silk-touch drops into ME. Stops if ME cannot accept them. Protected or unbreakable blocks, containers, machines and multi-block objects are skipped.
tooltip.appliedas.wand.bind: Link in a Wireless Access Point, or sneak-right-click it.
tooltip.appliedas.wand.configure: Right-click air to open the configuration screen.
message.appliedas.wand.missing_combined: Insufficient ME and inventory materials: %s (need %s in total).
message.appliedas.wand.recovery_full: ME cannot accept the replaced blocks. Construction stopped.
message.appliedas.wand.recovery_pending: Recovery interrupted. Remaining resources are retained in the wand.
message.appliedas.wand.linked: ME Resonating Wand linked to this network.
message.appliedas.wand.unlinked: Link the wand to a Wireless Access Point first.
message.appliedas.wand.unavailable: The linked access point is missing or unloaded.
message.appliedas.wand.out_of_range: No active Wireless Access Point from this network is in range.
message.appliedas.wand.no_power: The ME network has insufficient power to supply this structure.
message.appliedas.wand.missing: Insufficient ME materials: %s (need %s; fluid amounts are in mB).
message.appliedas.wand.blocked: Cannot build at %s, %s, %s. Clear obstacles and check building permissions.
message.appliedas.wand.invalid_fluid: This fluid cannot form a source block here.
message.appliedas.wand.interrupted: Construction interrupted. Unused materials are returned or retained in the wand.
gui.appliedas.array.network_offline: ME network offline: check power and channels
gui.appliedas.array.catalyst_marker_hint: Insert the indicated item, or enable automatic supply.
gui.appliedas.array.catalyst_missing: No catalyst recipe found for the selected lumen.
gui.appliedas.array.lumen_hint: %s / 4000 Lm. Gold marker: reserve of %s Lm.
gui.appliedas.array.filaments_hint: Allow ME Lumen Filaments to draw lumen.
gui.appliedas.array.supply_hint: Restock liquid starlight and catalysts from ME.
gui.appliedas.array.switch_hint: Waiting for old lumen and catalyst to return to ME.
gui.appliedas.chalice.network_offline: ME offline: check power, channels, and connections.
gui.appliedas.chalice.pull_hint: Refill from ME to the reserve amount.
gui.appliedas.chalice.fluid_hint: %s / 64000 mB. Gold marker: reserve of %s mB.
gui.appliedas.chalice.interaction_hint: Right-click with a fluid container to transfer; empty hand to configure.
gui.appliedas.chalice.filter_hint: Drop a fluid; right-click with a container to mark; click empty-handed to clear.
gui.appliedas.chalice.switch_hint: Waiting for the old fluid to drain.
